needs.proposedSignature: A face declaration `annihilator?: number | Amount`; a `covers[].by` kind `annihilator` whose anchored line shape is /^annihilator (\d+|x)$/; the Keyword union gains 'annihilator' with a parameter slot so `grant-keyword` / `pump.keywords` / `anthem.keywords` / `aura.keywords` / `equipment.keywords` can grant it as `{ keyword: 'annihilator', n: Amount }`; a ScopeWho (or sacrifice `who`) value `'defending-player'`; and a KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS entry `annihilator: 'whenever ~ attacks, defending player sacrifices {n} permanents of their choice'`.
needs.semantics: CR 702.86a. Whenever a creature with annihilator N attacks, the DEFENDING PLAYER sacrifices N permanents of their choice. Three separate gaps: (1) no Keyword / declaration / covers kind names it, so the printed line 'Annihilator N' can be claimed by nothing; (2) the renderer has no rules text for it, so any ability that claims the line scores 0 and the card is capped below the 0.55 gate (measured on Ulamog's Crusher: a correct attacks trigger rendered as 'whenever ~ attacks, each opponent sacrifices 2 creatures' still scored 0.00 with gap keyword:annihilator); (3) 'defending player' is not a ScopeWho — `each-opponent` is the only approximation and is wrong at three or more seats. Ulamog, the Defiler needs the amount to be an Amount (a +1/+1 counter count), and Eldrazi Conscription / Flayer of Loyalties / Hideous Taskmaster / Nazgûl Battle-Mace need it GRANTED with its number to another permanent.
needs.clause: Annihilator 2 (Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)
